description: Save and find links with rich previews, lists, tags, and notes. Nori gives your saved links a home. Collect articles, tools, and inspiration, then find them again with visual previews, lists, tags, and notes. Save with context Keep links in custom lists, add tags, and attach personal notes. Browse rich bookmark cards with cover images or page screenshots, or switch to a compact view. Find what you saved Search your bookmarks and filter by list or tag. Jump back to recently used links from history without hunting through your collection. Organize in batches Select several bookmarks to move them between lists, hide them, share them, or delete them together. Save from other apps Send links to Nori through Android's share menu. Choose the destination list before saving, or enable quick save for your preferred list. Make it yours Choose light, dark, or pure black AMOLED themes. Pick an accent color or create your own, adjust text size, and choose the bookmark layout that suits you. Read your way Open saved links in your system browser or an in-app browser. Keep your collection with you Your bookmarks are stored locally. An optional paid Nori Sync plan lets you sync lists and bookmarks across devices after signing in.
